subject: Base House
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a clean grayscale pencil-and-ink 3D MODELING REFERENCE SKETCH SHEET for Fire Slop, a comic stylized rescue game. White background, confident dark contours, very light gray planar shading, simplified chunky low-poly-friendly geometry, few large details. NOT a photoreal render, NOT a screenshot. One consistent object design across all views, uncluttered generous separation, all silhouettes fully in frame. Landscape sheet. Large three-quarter hero view plus smaller aligned front, side and rear or top views as appropriate. Minimal English view labels and title only; no invented dimension numbers, no watermark, no flames, smoke, UI or scene clutter. Shapes must be clear enough for a 3D artist to reconstruct. Title: Base House. Use attached city building reference for architecture: rectangular urban apartment building with flat roof, chunky projecting window surrounds, corner quoins, simple cornice and sparse exposed-brick accents on plain plaster. Adapt to EXACTLY THREE FULL STOREYS including ground floor, NOT four or five. Four window bays across front; central ground-level entrance replaces a window where necessary. No balconies, no exterior stairs. Accessible flat roof with low parapet, small clearly visible stair-access rooftop enclosure and enough empty roof for large drone landing; roof enclosure is NOT another full storey. Ground entrance and second-storey rescue window readable. Large three-quarter building sketch plus matching front, side and roof-plan views. All elevations consistent three floors. Plain white background, intact building, no fire/smoke, no neighboring houses or vehicles. Sparse grayscale material cues, blockout-friendly modular facade, not detailed brick texture.
notes: Three storeys, flat accessible roof and stair-access enclosure. This is an exterior concept, not an interior floor plan. Resolve the ground-floor side-window mismatch in blockout: use the side elevation for that opening. The second-floor rescue opening and rooftop landing clearance still require gameplay blockout validation. The double entrance door is a separate facade variant from the single apartment-door sheet.
